weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the specific contributions of the paper, particularly in relation to the novelty of the proposed quadratic models.
The experimental setup lacks a comprehensive comparison with existing models, which limits the assessment of the proposed method's effectiveness.
Key assumptions regarding the conditions under which the catapult dynamics occur are not sufficiently detailed, which may affect the reproducibility of the results.
The paper does not adequately address the limitations of the quadratic models in comparison to more complex neural network architectures.
strengths: The paper presents a novel approach to understanding neural network dynamics through the lens of quadratic models, contributing to the theoretical framework of neural networks.
The analysis of catapult dynamics provides valuable insights into the optimization behavior of neural networks under large learning rates.
Empirical results support the theoretical claims, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed models in capturing non-linear dynamics.
